title: How to Join RS Boost, ReelShort's Affiliate Program
description: Step-by-step: sign up for RS Boost, add an invitation code, and get your first ReelShort promotion link. Plain guide from a channel that uses it.
h1: How to join RS Boost, step by step
lead: RS Boost is how ReelShort pays creators who send viewers to its dramas. Here is the sign-up path we used, without the hype.
disclosure: The code above is our referral code. Using it may raise our commission rate with ReelShort. It costs you nothing.

ul: An email address you check, for the account and its notices.
At least one place to share dramas: a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram or Facebook account, or a site.
An invitation code if you want to bind one. Ours is above.

steps: Go to cps.reelshort.com and choose to register.
Enter the account details the form asks for.
Paste an invitation code in the invitation code field if you have one.
Read the terms of service before you accept them. They decide what promotion is allowed.
Confirm your account and log in.

p: In the dashboard, pick a drama and generate its promotion link or code. Share that exact link. Do not shorten it through another redirect or deep-link into the app another way, because RS Boost's terms limit deep-linking and tracking only works on the links it gives you.
RS Boost pays on a cost-per-sale basis, so you earn when your viewers pay in the app, not per view. We do not publish income figures: they depend on your audience and the terms in your dashboard.

faq.a: Creators who promote ReelShort dramas online. The terms let you choose your own media, but rule out illegal sites and advise against sites aimed at minors.

faq.q: Can I promote RS Boost dramas on my own website?
faq.a: RS Boost's terms say you may share its materials and links on online media you choose, so a site of your own is allowed as long as you follow the rest of the terms.
The sign-up form has a field for one. If you have a code, add it there; you can request ours by email on our invite code page.
On a cost-per-sale basis, under the payment terms shown in the RS Boost terms and dashboard.
